title: Aurora, trained with PCC-RL's code, exported for agent_rate and checked against PCC-RL's code
description: The Aurora trained by experiments/aurora-train.json (release exp-aurora-train-199), exported by experiments/aurora_export.py for an agent_rate agent: PCC-RL's three features from agent_rate's monitor-interval statistics, its 10-interval history, the policy's mean and its rate factor 1 + 0.025 a (or 1 / (1 - 0.025 a)). experiments/aurora_weights.py runs PCC-RL's own sender_obs.py and loaded_agent.py (64bea6e) on the SavedModel over 600 synthetic monitor intervals, and each export is checked against it step by step (aurora/check.txt). aurora/aurora.onnx is the policy as trained; aurora/aurora-blind.onnx is the same policy fed the RTT samples PCC-Uspace's deployment gives it (the first and last only, truncated to whole seconds, so 0 below 1 s). Run either as NAME=PATH@rate. Later experiments take this release as an input.
run: R="$IN/train/aurora"; (cd "$R" && sha256sum -c --quiet SHA256SUMS); T=$(mktemp -d); git clone --quiet https://github.com/PCCproject/PCC-RL.git "$T/pcc"; git -C "$T/pcc" checkout --quiet 64bea6eeee3a3e558449c35b6496cf596f5ded52; uv venv --quiet --python 3.8 "$T/tf"; uv pip install --quiet --python "$T/tf/bin/python" tensorflow-cpu==2.4.1 numpy==1.19.5 protobuf==3.20.3; mkdir -p "$OUT/aurora/ref"; uv run python experiments/aurora_export.py stream "$OUT/aurora/ref/stream.npz"; "$T/tf/bin/python" -I experiments/aurora_weights.py "$T/pcc" "$R/model" "$OUT/aurora/ref/stream.npz" "$OUT/aurora/ref"; uv run python experiments/aurora_export.py export "$OUT/aurora/ref" "$OUT/aurora/aurora.onnx" | tee "$OUT/aurora/check.txt"; uv run python experiments/aurora_export.py export "$OUT/aurora/ref" "$OUT/aurora/aurora-blind.onnx" --blind | tee -a "$OUT/aurora/check.txt"; cp "$R/LICENSE-pcc-rl.txt" "$OUT/aurora/"; (cd "$OUT/aurora" && sha256sum -- aurora.onnx aurora-blind.onnx check.txt LICENSE-pcc-rl.txt ref/*.npz ref/*.npy > SHA256SUMS)
